name: Shadowforge Flame Keepers always drop the Lyceum torch
contract: Shadowforge Torch 11885 is consumed when lighting the Lyceum braziers. Upstream #27732 records live research confirming guaranteed Flame Keeper drops. The effective CoA loot template 9956 retains the legacy 94.3506 percent ordinary, ungrouped single-item row and 300-second spawns. Sample 1000 native loot fills: every fill must contain the torch. Anvilrage Soldier 8893 stays unable to drop the torch and Runecloth 14047 remains an ordinary non-guaranteed drop. This verifies native loot generation, not the brazier interaction or dungeon completion.
